data.text: Criteria 1, 2 and 4 of KAD-73 are the board's definition of done and do not apply to it: the change is copy and components in kadence-site, which has no test suite, and the core was not touched. Typecheck (3) is the site's own, clean, and next build passed. Checked by hand in the browser instead: desktop and 375 px with no horizontal scroll, no console errors, the merge-test and how-it-works docs pages render the moved figures, every old anchor resolves.
